biggest_catch: Allow 4-6 weeks after the friend completes all requirements before your gift card arrives.
catches: Referrer earns a $50 Mastercard Gift Card for each individual referred who registers, opens a new account, and completes the requirements.
Referrer must complete the Official Referral Card and share it; it must be submitted at the time of account opening or mailed within two weeks.
Qualifying accounts: new checking account (personal or business) with direct deposit and e-statement enrollment within 60 days, OR a qualifying loan (home purchase/build, refinance, or HELOC).
The referred person must not already have an active relationship with Better Banks.
Employees of Better Banks and their immediate families are ineligible.
Gift card value may be reported to the IRS.
Program may be discontinued or changed at any time without notice.
No referral cap stated on the official page.
